test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following places has been INCORRECTLY paired with its pass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: Jelep La - Zaskar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jelep La** is a high mountain pass located between **India and Tibet** in the Sikkim region.
 
• **Zaskar** is a sub-range of the Himalayas in the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, and it is not associated with Jelep La.
 
• The correct pair for Jelep La would be **Jelep La - Sikkim**.
 
• The other options are correctly paired as follows:
 
 
• **Banihal** Pass - Pir Panjal Range
 
• **Khardung La** - Ladakh Range
 
• **Zoji La** - Great Himalayas
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jelep La**

 
 
• Jelep La is a mountain pass in the Eastern Himalayas, located at a height of about 4,267 meters (14,000 feet).
 
• It connects Sikkim in India to the Chumbi Valley in Tibet.
 
• The pass is historically significant as it was part of the ancient silk route used for trade between India and Tibet.
 
 
 
• **Banihal Pass**
 
 
• Banihal Pass is situated in the Pir Panjal range in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It lies at an altitude of 2,832 meters (9,291 feet) and connects the Kashmir Valley with the outer Himalayas and the rest of India.
 
 
 
• **Khardung La**
 
 
• Khardung La is a high mountain pass located in the Ladakh region of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It is situated at an altitude of 5,359 meters (17,582 feet) and is one of the highest motorable roads in the world.
 
 
 
• **Zoji La**
 
 
• Zoji La is a high mountain pass situated in the Great Himalayas.
 
• It connects the Kashmir Valley with the Dras and Suru valleys of the Kargil district.
 
• Zoji La is located at an altitude of approximately 3,528 meters (11,575 feet).
